subject: Game Theory
title: Patent Races
description: A fast breakdown of Patent Races for builders.

hook.text: Pfizer and Moderna raced to develop COVID vaccines. The winner would earn billions. The loser: nothing.

buildup.text: Patent races are all-pay auctions: every firm spends on R&D, but only the winner gets the patent.

discovery.text: The competitive pressure speeds innovation but also causes wasteful duplication of research effort.

twist.text: Firms over-invest when the prize is large. Patent races can burn more resources than the invention is worth.

climax.text: Strategic timing matters: some firms wait until rivals commit, then sprint to finish second-but-better.

punchline.text: Innovation races reward speed over perfection.

quiz.question: Why are patent races compared to all-pay auctions?
options: Every firm spends on R&D but only the winner profits
